changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE app.EmailProviderConfigurations ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, Provider NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, DisplayName NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, IsEnabled BIT NOT NULL, IsActive BIT NOT NULL, SmtpHost NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, SmtpPort INT NOT NULL, Encryption NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, AuthenticationEnabled BIT NOT NULL, Username NVARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, ProtectedPassword NVARCHAR(4000) NULL, SenderName NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, SenderEmail NVARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, ReplyToEmail NVARCHAR(320) NULL, ConnectionTimeoutSeconds INT NOT NULL, MaxEmailsPerMinute INT NOT NULL, MaxDeliveryAttempts INT NOT NULL, RetryBaseDelaySeconds INT NOT NULL, ConfigVersion INT NOT NULL, LastTestedAt DATETIME2 NULL, LastTestStatus NVARCHAR(32) NULL, LastTestMessage NVARCHAR(500) NULL, LastEmailSentAt DATETIME2 NULL, LastEmailStatus NVARCHAR(32) NULL, HealthStatus NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_EmailProviderConfigurations PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_EmailProviderConfigurations_Provider CHECK (Provider IN (N'SmtpHostinger', N'SmtpGeneric', N'SendGrid', N'AmazonSes')), CONSTRAINT CK_EmailProviderConfigurations_Encryption CHECK (Encryption IN (N'SslTls', N'StartTls')), CONSTRAINT CK_EmailProviderConfigurations_Health CHECK (HealthStatus IN (N'NotTested', N'Healthy', N'Failed', N'Disabled')), CONSTRAINT CK_EmailProviderConfigurations_Port CHECK (SmtpPort BETWEEN 1 AND 65535), CONSTRAINT CK_EmailProviderConfigurations_Timeout CHECK (ConnectionTimeoutSeconds BETWEEN 1 AND 120), CONSTRAINT CK_EmailProviderConfigurations_Rate CHECK (MaxEmailsPerMinute BETWEEN 1 AND 600), CONSTRAINT CK_EmailProviderConfigurations_Attempts CHECK (MaxDeliveryAttempts BETWEEN 1 AND 20), CONSTRAINT CK_EmailProviderConfigurations_Retry CHECK (RetryBaseDelaySeconds BETWEEN 5 AND 3600) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_EmailProviderConfigurations_IsActive ON app.EmailProviderConfigurations (IsActive) WHERE IsActive = 1 AND DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_EmailProviderConfigurations_Provider ON app.EmailProviderConfigurations (Provider) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;
CREATE TABLE app.EmailDeliveryLogs ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, RelatedTenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, Recipient NVARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, Subject NVARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, TemplateKey NVARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, Provider NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, Classification NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, AttemptCount INT NOT NULL, MaxAttempts INT NOT NULL, ProviderMessageId NVARCHAR(200) NULL, FailureReason NVARCHAR(500) NULL, IdempotencyKey NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, OutboxMessageId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, CorrelationId NVARCHAR(100) NULL, QueuedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, SentAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_EmailDeliveryLogs PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_EmailDeliveryLogs_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_EmailDeliveryLogs_RelatedTenant FOREIGN KEY (RelatedTenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_EmailDeliveryLogs_Status CHECK (Status IN ( N'Queued', N'Processing', N'Accepted', N'Delivered', N'Retrying', N'Failed', N'Bounced', N'Suppressed')), CONSTRAINT CK_EmailDeliveryLogs_Classification CHECK (Classification IN (N'Transactional', N'Test')), CONSTRAINT UX_EmailDeliveryLogs_IdempotencyKey UNIQUE (IdempotencyKey) ); CREATE INDEX IX_EmailDeliveryLogs_CreatedAtUtc ON app.EmailDeliveryLogs (CreatedAt DESC) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_EmailDeliveryLogs_Status_CreatedAtUtc ON app.EmailDeliveryLogs (Status, CreatedAt DESC) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_EmailDeliveryLogs_TenantId_CreatedAtUtc ON app.EmailDeliveryLogs (TenantId, CreatedAt DESC) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_EmailDeliveryLogs_TemplateKey ON app.EmailDeliveryLogs (TemplateKey) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS app.EmailDeliveryLogs; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS app.EmailProviderConfigurations;
